title: The Arcana Cathexis
author: Tom "SteepInKline" Kline
description:
Journey to the remote Bastion Arcanum, where a collection of treasures known as the Arcana Cathexis are said to be hidden. Along the way, you might just learn something about yourself...

A Twine game written for a Creative Writing independent study in hypertext and interactive fiction in Fall 2014 at SUNY Oswego.
